notes.title: Danchi Days Demo - check out our new summer adventure!
notes.content:
Hello, Analgesic fans! Melos Han-Tani here. Did you know I've been working on a 2nd game in addition to Angeline Era?
It's called Danchi Days! And we have a demo out now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3312850/Danchi_Days_Demo/

It's a slice-of-life adventure set in a 2000's Japanese setting, where you control a girl named Hoshino! You'll explore her neighborhood, while hoping to revive the local summer festival for her beloved grandmother. It's a moving story with a lot of memorable characters. I hope you'll like it!

I'm working on it with a separate team of 3 (gingham games), but publishing it under Analgesic. We'd love for you to try the demo out and leave a review!

notes.title: Anodyne Remastered is out now + Sale!
notes.content:
Good news - Anodyne has received a remaster to celebrate its 10th anniversary, and it's on sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/234900/Anodyne/

Q: What's new?

- Linux support!
- Play the game in smooth 60 FPS, unlocked FPS, or keep it on 30 FPS for a classic flair!
- New secret Boss Rush mode lets you challenge all the bosses in one go!
- Full, Steam Deck-verified controller support and input rebinding!
- Fixed achievements on mac
- The minimap now shows the location of treasure boxes in rooms you’ve visited, as well as floor number information in dungeons.
- Use new controls to quickly swap between weapon extensions!
- New approachability options let you toggle on more health drops, invincibility and more
- Multiple save files and a save copy option
- The game, graphics, music - and secrets - remain the same as the original 2013 release.
- The original Anodyne remains playable on all stores. (Save files do not transfer, though.)

Q: How do I play?
A: If on Steam, simply select "Remaster" when starting the game. On GOG, it will play automatically (but you can play the original by changing launch settings.) For Itch and Humble, simply look in the "Remaster" folder in your download.

Q: Do my saves carry over?
A: No, but your old saves for the original remain.

Q: Steam achievements?
A: These carry over.

Q: Consoles?
A: We are planning to launch this on consoles in 2024/5. 

Discuss this update: https://steamcommunity.com/app/234900/discussions/0/5943120984243937208/

notes.title: Sephonie now out! From Anodyne 2's creators
notes.content:
Hi Analgesic fans! Wanted to let you know our new 3D platformer, Sephonie, is out now, as well as the soundtrack. Get it and the soundtrack DLC here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248840

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021367/614ea89de8db3246c1b882cd0849e8c45c0a2dd3.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021367/1001752a7a3dd56b8185acb1784b21a70414fc17.png[/img]

Memories linger across time, deep beneath the island’s surface...
In this story-driven 3D platformer, explore Sephonie Island's massive cave network, and link with unidentified species using the novel Puzzle Grid system. Explore the island's depths as shipwrecked biologists Amy, Ing-wen, and Riyou, whose personal histories come to bear on the shifting spiritual landscape of the island depths.

Parkour-esque platforming

Use an acrobatic moveset to navigate lush, jade canopies and rusty sandstone spires. Fling yourself over high ledges using the satisfying Teledash Vault and deftly Wallrun across dangerous outcroppings.

Grapple through the air with the help of long-tongued Ribbats or climb tall cliffs via sticky-ridged Gripshrooms. Linking with certain creatures will grant you new abilities to reach the farthest depths of the island.

The Relaxing and Casual Puzzle Grid System

The trio must research the island's unknown creatures by Linking with them. Using the one-of-a-kind "Puzzle Grid" system, you'll rotate and place a series of multi-colored pieces onto the board to create large, same-colored islands. Each creature has different challenges to overcome!


There's no 'right' solution to Linking: use your intuition to react to the creature's moves and what appears on the board, and you will soon be on your way to success!

A Research Trip Gone Awry

In the near future, three biologists are on a joint mission to use their state-of-the-art ONYX implants to research the creatures of the uninhabited Sephonie Island. But as they approach the island, a sudden storm leaves them shipwrecked.

Amy Lim, Taiwanese-American and bold leader, hails from the midwestern USA town of Bloomington. Riyou Hayashi, an analytically-minded Japanese-Taiwanese researcher, calls the bustling Tokyo his home. And Ing-wen Lin, a kind and considerate Taiwanese scientist, lives in Taipei.

The trio will find their motivations and loyalties put to the test as they navigate Sephonie’s caverns, facing not only physical challenges but also their deepest memories and dreams. As they grow more intimate with each other and the island, an ancient force, brewing deep in the island's abyss, may threaten their newfound relationship, and the world...

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021367/c012f5e1556703c3d7aa10ec01bc957d82835326.png[/img]

notes.title: Linux Installation + Controller Instructions
notes.content:
If you're playing on Ubuntu, I've included source code and scripts that make setting up controller support as painless as possible. Though it still might be painful, but hey! You're using Linux, so this should be easy.


INSTALLATION:

Anodyne MUST be installed into the default steam directory in your home folder or achievements won't work. Sorry. 

If installation fails, you probably don't have Adobe AIR. Follow the instructions at my friend Lars' site to learn how to install Adobe AIR. http://www.defendersquest.com/linux.html

CONTROLLER SUPPORT:

Open a Terminal and navigate to the folder where Anodyne's installed (I think it's ~/.steam/steam/SteamApps/common/Anodyne or something).

Anyways inside there is a folder called "linux_controller". README.txt has instructions - you need to compile a joy2key program and a configuration program. Run the config once with your controller plugged in to make a controller configuration, then run joy2key once Anodyne is running, click on the Anodyne window and your controller input will be sent there.

INSTALLATION:

Anodyne MUST be installed into the default steam directory in your home folder or achievements won't work. Sorry. 

If installation fails, you probably don't have Adobe AIR. Follow the instructions at my friend Lars' site to learn how to install Adobe AIR. http://www.defendersquest.com/linux.html

CONTROLLER SUPPORT:

Open a Terminal and navigate to the folder where Anodyne's installed (I think it's ~/.steam/steam/SteamApps/common/Anodyne or something).

Anyways inside there is a folder called "linux_controller". README.txt has instructions - you need to compile a joy2key program and a configuration program. Run the config once with your controller plugged in to make a controller configuration, then run joy2key once Anodyne is running, click on the Anodyne window and your controller input will be sent there.
